originals.ko: 나는 그걸 그에게 주려고 노력하고 있어
originals.why: Wrong sense for this basket: 'rhoi o iddo fo' means 'give it to him' (its own LEGO, 그걸 그에게 주다), not 'put it' (rhoi fo ar…) as seed 314 teaches; it is also the 'o' variant, not 'fo'.
Wrong sense: rhoi fo iddo fo is 'give it to him', not the 'put it' sense this LEGO teaches. The Korean can't use the 놓다 gloss here without becoming unnatural.

originals.ko: 나는 그걸 그에게 다시 주지 않을 것 같아
originals.why: Wrong sense: 'give it to him', not 'put it'. The Korean has to use 주다 rather than the LEGO gloss 놓다.

originals.ko: 너 내일 오후에 그걸 그에게 줄 필요가 있어?
originals.why: Wrong sense: 'rhoi o iddo fo' means 'give it to him' (a separate LEGO, and the 'o' variant), not the 'put it' sense taught here.
Wrong sense: 'rhoi fo iddi hi' means 'give it to her'. 그걸 그녀에게 놓다 would be unnatural Korean, so this row cannot practise the 'put it' sense.

originals.ko: 나는 지금 그걸 그에게 주면 좋겠어
originals.why: Wrong sense: 'give it to him', not the 'put it' sense this LEGO teaches.

originals.ko: 우리는 오늘 그걸 그에게 주고 싶었어
originals.why: Wrong sense: 'give it to him', not the 'put it' sense this LEGO teaches.
Does not contain 'rhoi fo' at all: 'rhoi amser iddo fo' means 'give him time', so it does not practise this LEGO.
